title.es: Aquel en el que Marta piensa menos en Fina
title.en: The One Where Marta Thinks Less of Fina

description.es: Marta y Andrés hablan. Marta le confiesa que ya no piensa en Fina a todas horas. Marta piensa en Fina y escribe en su diario, donde elogia a Cloe y señala que parece interesada en ella. Marta le comenta a Pelayo que Cloe se siente atraída por ella. Pelayo le advierte que no ponga en riesgo su matrimonio liándose con ella. Cuando llega Cloe, Pelayo besa a Marta en los labios.
description.en: Marta and Andrés talk. Marta confesses to him that she no longer thinks about Fina every hour of the day. Marta thinks of Fina and writes in her diary, where she praises Cloe and notes that she seems interested in her. Marta mentions to Pelayo that Cloe is attracted to her. Pelayo warns her not to jeopardize their marriage by getting involved with her. When Cloe arrives, Pelayo kisses Marta on the lips.
